comment: Allowlist of licenses for the production dependencies: OSI-approved licenses, with specific, temporary exceptions for build dependencies. See CONTRIBUTING.md. SPDX ids; OR expressions pass if one alternative is here, AND requires all of them. Exceptions: date and expires in YYYY-MM-DD, a period of at most 183 days; an npm package may end in * (prefix).

exceptions.reason: Accepts CC-BY-4.0 for caniuse-lite, a non-OSI dependency used in the next/browserslist build tool; attribution in docs/third-party-notices.md. It is not distributed in the portal standalone, and that absence is checked in the image test. Review on expiry.

The LGPL libvips package is a transitive dependency used in the Next install/build. Image optimization is turned off and sharp and libvips are removed from the standalone before the final image; the image test verifies the absence. A temporary build exception, not an authorization to distribute the library; review on expiry.

khroma is MIT-licensed (license file in the package and in its repository), but its package.json has no license field, so the checker reads it as Unknown. It is a transitive dependency of mermaid, which draws the diagrams of the guides at /docs. Review on expiry; remove once the package declares its license.
